status: Fixed before phase8 outcome computation; exploratory follow-up to phase7, not independent preregistration
goal: Test uncertain-boundary predictions against IT and inspect original image evidence
transcription_match: Exactly phase7 rule: one surviving span per locus in each transcription, identical letter stream; fragments may exclude edges
model: Frozen ZL phase7 four-character predictor, quire held out. No training or threshold tuning in phase8
image_selection: For each of f1r,f75r,f103r, select lowest and highest frozen four-context probability among ZL uncertain positions; ties by locus,span,offset. Select before viewing chosen lines. Six positions total, no replacements for failures.
image_review: Assistant, non-blind, guided by transcriptions and predictions. This is a targeted feasibility audit, not representative measurement or expert independent validation. Preserve inconclusive sites.
image_geometry: Record manually localized boundaries on unmodified Yale images. Crop only for inspection, no synthesis or generative restoration. If geometry cannot be localized reliably, abstain.
conclusions: No semantic reading, no automatic corrections to source. Model probabilities are not calibrated truth probabilities. IT is a second transcription of the same manuscript, not ground truth.
